to: A handoff cannot name the files the receiving hand may change

The path list is a record, not a check: repeatable --with <path> values are stored on the handoff event and exposed by handoff --json and log, so a later reader can act on the grant without parsing prose. Handoff ends before the receiving hand works and has no runtime handle that could enforce its later diff; claiming enforcement here would be a promise the command cannot keep.
